title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Objektplanung gem. Par.34 HOAI, LPH 1-9
description: Objektplanungsleistungen gem. § 34 HOAI Leistungsphasen 1-9, für den Neubau des Einsatzmittellagers einer Feuerwache sowie Dienstwohnungen. Planung einer vorrübergehenden Nutzung der Flächen als Interimsquartier für den Ausbildungsbetrieb der Feuerwehr- & Rettungsdienstschule Der Standort ist ein freies stadteigenes Grundstück in München Aubing, im Bereich der Gewerbeflächen Langenburg-, Kronwinkler- und Kastelburgstraße. Geplant ist das Einsatzmittellager der Feuerwache Aubing mit einer Abstellhalle für Abrollcontainer, einem Lagerbereich für Hochregallager, Werkstätten und die dazugehörige Verwaltung. In den darüberliegenden Geschossen über der zweigeschossigen Abstellhalle sollen Dienstwohnungen untergebracht werden. Die Wohnungen sollen von 2-, bis 4-Zimmer-Wohnungen angeboten werden und eine eigene Adresse erhalten. Das Wachgebäude der FW Aubing mit Fahrzeughalle, Wachbetrieb und Ruheräumen soll erst zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt geplant und umgesetzt werden und ist nicht Teil der Planung. Die Planung hat das Wachgebäude jedoch mit zu berücksichtigen, vor allem in Bezug auf die Erschließung. In dem Gebäuderiegel entlang der Kastelburgstraße soll vorab eine Interimsnutzung für Teile der Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienstschule (FRSM) aus der Aidenbachstraße aufgenommen werden. Die in dem Bauteil im Erdgeschoss vorgesehenen zukünftigen Abstellhallen für Abrollcontainer, Werkstätten und Sozialbereiche sollen für die FRSM als Fahrzeugabstellgassen und Schulungssäle genutzt werden. Die Halle des Paletten-Regallagers für Einsatzmittel kann vorab als Übungshalle der FRSM dienen. Außenflächen werden vorab als Übungsflächen befestigt. Der Aufwand für die Änderungen und Umbauten für die finale Nutzung als Einsatzmittellager ist planerisch schon frühzeitig abzustimmen und zu minimieren. Das genehmigte, vorläufige Nutzerbedarfsprogramm liegt den Anlagen bei. Ebenfalls sind die Anforderungen an Standard und Ausstattung und an Freiflächen dem vorläufigen Nutzerbedarfsprogramm zu entnehmen. Die vorläufigen Flächenbedarfe sowohl für das Einsatzmittellager als auch die Interimsflächen sind in der Anlage Raumprogramm dargestellt. Die Machbarkeitsstudie und Flächenüberlegungen der Branddirektion für die Interimsnutzung liegen als Anlage zum Verfahren bei. Die betriebliche, wirtschaftliche und dabei nachhaltige Umsetzbarkeit eines schlüssigen Gesamtkonzepts, unter Berücksichtigung der Interims- sowie der finalen Nutzung sind wesentliche Anforderungen. Ein Bebauungsplan liegt nicht vor, baurechtliche Beurteilung nach § 30 Abs. BauGB in Verbindung mit § 34 Abs.1 BauGB. Vorbescheid 2023 wurde positiv beschieden. Anforderungen an Freiflächen Für den Außenbereich sind besonders die PKW Stellplätze sowie der Übungshof von besonderer Bedeutung. Eine Tiefgarage sollte nach Möglichkeit vermieden werden. Die im Raumprogramm genannte Anzahl Stellplätze stellt jeweils die Maximalzahl dar. In der Vorplanung ist anhand der umsetzbaren Flächen eine Ermittlung der Stellplätze in Vorabklärung mit der LBK und den baurechtlichen Vorgaben durchzuführen. Der Übungshof dient zur Durchführung von Übungen. Es ist dabei eine versiegelte Manipulationsfläche vorzusehen, um bei Übungen das Eindringen von Ölen und Flüssigkeiten in das Erdreich zu verhindern, die bei Übungen mit Schrott-Pkw austreten können. Dienstwohnungsgebäude müssen einschließlich Freifläche und Spielplatz den Wohnungsbauvorschriften entsprechen.

title: Germany – Museum-exhibition services – Niederzier, BIZ Sophienhöhe - Kuration und Ausstellungskonzept
description: Kernbestandteil der ausgeschriebenen Leistung ist die Kuration und Planung einer Ausstellung in Anlehnung an die HOAS2 (Leistungsphasen 03-07) für das Besucher- und Informationszentrum (BIZ) auf der Sophienhöhe in Niederzier. Das allgemeine Aufgabenverständnis erfordert ein Zusammenspiel zwischen inhaltlicher Tiefe, kreativer Vermittlung und der Einbindung in den räumlichen Kontext. Die Ausstellung soll als zentraler Informationspunkt der Region dienen, der nicht nur Wissen vermittelt, sondern auch zum Entdecken und Erleben einlädt. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Verknüpfung des Innen- und Außenraums, um den Erlebnischarakter der Ausstellung zu stärken. Hierbei gilt es, die Metamorphosen der Landschaft - von der Nutzung als Tagebau über die von Anfang an mitgedachte Rekultivierung bis hin zur heutigen Biodiversität und Erholungsnutzung - als roter Faden zu veranschaulichen. Multimediale und interaktive Mittel sollen genutzt werden, um Besuchenden unterschiedliche Blickwinkel auf die rekultivierte Landschaft der Sophienhöhe und die umliegenden Bereiche zu ermöglichen. Die Ausstellung ist als flexibles, resilientes, modulares Konzept zu entwickeln, das verschiedene Nutzungsanforderungen integriert. Die Rückkopplung mit der z.T. parallellaufenden Gebäude- bzw. Freianlagenplanung ist dabei unbedingt erforderlich. Die Aufgabe erfordert eine fundierte Analyse der Gegebenheiten und Zielgruppenbedarfe sowie die Entwicklung kreativer und zielgruppengerechter Vermittlungslösungen für die Ausstellung als Wissensplattform, Forum und Erlebnisraum. Grundvoraussetzung ist dabei eine inhaltlich fundierte, didaktisch überzeugende und funktionale Entwicklung der Ausstellung. Die Kuration und Ausstellungsgestaltung wird durch die Projektgruppe, bestehend aus der Neuland Hambach GmbH (vsl. Bauherrin), Starke Projekte GmbH (Beschaffung und Beratung) und der RWE Power AG (Flächeneigentümerin und Rekultivierungsverantwortliche) engmaschig begleitet. Unmittelbar relevante Akteure (z.B. benachbarte Tagebauumfeldinitiativen, FZJülich, lokale Museen mit hoher Themenrelevanz sowie lokale Akteur:innen und Initiativen) sollen in die Bearbeitung eingebunden werden. In die Entwicklung eingebunden ist zudem der Landschaftsverband Rheinland (LVR), der die Entwicklung der Informationszentren im Rheinischen Revier moderiert und inhaltliche Grundlagen und Impulse für die Ausstellung einbringt. Das sind neben dem BIZ auf der Sophienhöhe auch das Dokumentationszentrum Garzweiler, das Infozentrum am Indemann, das forum:terra nova "Welcome Center" sowie das ehemalige Kraftwerk Frimmersdorf. Bei Bedarf werden auch die zuständigen Behörden (insbes. Bezirksregierungen Köln und Arnsberg als Planungs- und Aufsichtsbehörden) zur Projektgruppe eingeladen. Mit der Projektgruppe sind digitale Abstimmungstermine vorgesehen. In mindestens einem Termin soll das Ergebnis der Kuration und Entwurfsplanung in einem politischen Gremium (in Präsenz) vorgestellt werden. Ein weiterer Austausch soll nach Bedarf mit der Auftraggeberin erfolgen.

Tarjouspyynnön liitteessä Palvelukuvaus Ylläpitosiiivous on tarkemmat tiedot hankinnan sisällöstä. Kyseessä on säännöllisesti toistuva palvelu, jota tilataan sopimuskauden aikana erillisinä toimeksiantoina tarpeen mukaan. Tarjouspyynnön liitteessä Palvelukuvaus Erikoissiivoukset on tarkemmat tiedot hankinnan sisällöstä.

title: Army Data Operations Center (ADOC) Industry Summit � Road to Improved Data Sharing in the Army Data Eco-system
description: Title of Event: Army Data Operations Center (ADOC) Industry Summit � Road to improved data sharing and access in the Army data eco-system Audience: Department of War Contractors and Government Stakeholders When: 27 Oct 2026 Where: Virtual via MS Teams Army Data Operations Center will conduct an Industry Summit on 27 October 2026 via Army MS Teams in order to brief Industry on ADOC activities/capabilities and to inform ADOC Full Operational Capability. Key tasks center around an explanation of what the Army Data Operations Center is, the vision for Army Data Governance and Accessibility, outlining current capability roadmaps, and identifying gaps to Industry and Key DOW Stakeholders. **NOTICE OF SPECIAL INTEREST / INDUSTRY ENGAGEMENT DISCLAIMER** **No Solicitation or Pending RFP:** This announcement is issued solely for information-sharing and market research purposes in support of the Army Data Operations Center (ADOC) Industry Summit. This engagement does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quote (RFQ), or an Invitation for Bid (IFB). There is no pending contract, solicitation, or procurement action anticipated as a direct result of this event. **No Commitment by the Government:** Participation in the ADOC Industry Summit is completely voluntary. The U.S. Army will not pay for any information submitted, nor will it reimburse vendors for preparation, or any other costs associated with attending or responding to this notice. DOW Briefers include: Army Data Operations Center The Desired End State: ADOC receives and incorporates feedback from Industry Summit participants into the ADOC Lessons Learned Wiki and Rolodex. Industry and DOW Stakeholders have a shared understanding of the Army Data Operations Center�s mission and DOW Data governance & accessibility challenges. This Industry Summit will be held at the CUI level and will be 100% Virtual via Army MS Teams ADOC Focus Areas The Army Data Operations Center (ADOC) is hosting this Industry Summit to foster a technical exchange with industry leaders, innovators, and practitioners. The primary objective is to understand how industry-proven methodologies can be applied to modernize, secure, and scale Army enterprise data infrastructure. During the technical sessions, ADOC is specifically interested in hearing briefings, live demonstrations, and case studies addressing the following core focus areas provided by priority: # Focus Area Participation Criteria 1 Data Platform Support: Describe your current and past performance supporting Army Data platforms (legacy or new systems). What specific technical and operational environments have you actively supported? 2 "As Code" Governance: Detail your methodology and past implementation of "Documentation as Code" and "Policy as Code" within secure DoW or federal enterprise environments to automate governance. 3 Access Control Frameworks: Explain how your solutions implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) to enforce security while ensuring secure, mission-appropriate data sharing. 4 Reusability & Products: What is your proven approach to developing stable, discoverable, and reusable baseline data products to reduce duplicate engineering efforts across enterprise platforms? 5 Emerging Trends & AI: How do your solutions leverage AI/ML to optimize governance workflows, analyze request patterns, and improve operational efficiency within a regulated data ecosystem? AGENDA: This is a single day event. Each Vendor will have a 30-minute block for presentations and Q&A. ADOC reserves the right to extend/reduce time in the final agenda. Each participating vendor will have a sperate dedicated Team Meetings established for their allocated time with ADOC government civilian/military personnel. TIME TOPIC 0815-0850 MS Teams Connectivity Checks 0850-0900 Admin Opening 0900-0950 Opening Comments & ADOC Mission and Task Force outcomes 0950-1000 Break 1000-1030 Vendor 1 Presentation and Q&A 1030-1100 Vendor 2 Presentation and Q&A 1100-1130 Vendor 3 Presentation and Q&A 1130-1300 Break 1300-1330 Vendor 4 Presentation and Q&A 1330-1400 Vendor 5 Presentation and Q&A 1400-1430 Vendor 6 Presentation and Q&A 1430-1400 Break 1430-1500 Vendor 7 Presentation and Q&A 1500-1530 Vendor 8 Presentation and Q&A 1530-1600 Additional Vender Presentations (if needed) 1600-1630 Additional Vender Presentations (if needed) 1630 -event end- Reservations: Eligibility to participate is limited to DOW Contractors and GOV Stakeholders with access to CUI and Army MS Teams. Each Industry organization will be limited to a maximum of three (3) attendees with a high preference for vendor data engineers/scientist participation. There is no fee. Meals will not be provided by the government at this event. The Government will not reimburse participants for any fees related to this event. Criteria for Participation: Industry partners interested in attending the ADOC Industry Summit must submit an email with subject line: " ADOC Industry Summit 27 October 2026 Participation Request� to the administrative POC no later than 1600 hrs EDST on 09 October 2027. The email should contain the following information: Administrative Details for Vendor Participation Company Name: CAGE code (if applicable), business unit, and address. title: Field-Scale Simulation Modelling and Agrohydrologic Assessment Services for Prairie Cropping Systems
description: DESCRIPTION: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) AAFC requires a Contractor to conduct field-scale, process-based simulation modelling using measured soil, crop, nutrient, and management datasets from AAFC research fields in Manitoba, and to develop calibrated and evaluated model configurations suitable for assessing, at whole field and management-zone scales, the impacts of alternative cropping systems and climate variability on: • Crop productivity (e.g., yield, biomass) for crops such as wheat, canola, soybean, barley, and/or other crops represented in AAFC datasets; • Soil water dynamics (e.g., soil moisture, plant-available water, water stress indices, drainage/leaching indicators as supported by the modelling framework); • Evapotranspiration (ET) and related water balance components (as supported by the modelling framework and available inputs); • Nutrient cycling and loss indicators, including nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) loss pathways (e.g., leaching/runoff/loss indicators as supported by the model framework); and • Long-term soil carbon dynamics (e.g., soil organic carbon trajectories under alternative rotations and management, as supported by the modelling framework and available datasets). This work will include simulation-based evaluation of cash crop systems and exploration of integrating cover crops and/or perennial phases into Prairie rotations, leveraging established cultivar coefficients/parameters where available in the selected model(s) (e.g., DSSAT or equivalent process-based model, including EPIC, APEX/ArcAPEX, DNDC, DayCent, STICS, APSIM, or RZWQM). A parallel agricultural hydrology component will strengthen the representation and evaluation of soil water processes using available AAFC soil moisture, yield, soil physical/chemical properties, and annual fertility datasets. The contract period is anticipated from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2027 with an irrevocable option to extend it for up to one additional one-year period. Policy on Reciprocal Procurement This solicitation of offers is open only to Canadian suppliers (if subject to any international trade agreement(s) and to Suppliers of an applicable trading partner. Mandatory Technical Criteria Requirements Bids will be assessed in accordance with the entire requirement of the bid solicitation including the technical and financial evaluation criteria. Basis of selection: Highest Combined Rating of Technical Merit and Price The bid solicitation contains mandatory and point-rated technical evaluation criteria. The responsive bid with the highest combined rating of technical merit and price will be recommended for award of a contract. SOLICITATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED TO AAFC AT: This bid solicitation allows bidders to use the CPC Connect service provided by Canada Post Corporation to transmit their bid electronically. Bidders must refer to Part 4 entitled Offer Submission of the bid solicitation for further information. Refer to the attached solicitation documents to obtain further information. Canada retains the right to negotiate with any supplier on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. PROCURING OFFICE: Melissa Smith, Procurement Specialist Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada Western Service Centre 300 – 2010 12th Avenue Regina, SK S4P 0M3 Telephone: 306-515-4796 E-mail address: melissa.smith3@agr.gc.ca AAFC has adopted the Integrity Regime administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada. title: Lieferung von einem Sperrgut-Pressfahrzeug
description: Die zu vergebende Gesamtleistung besteht aus der Lieferung von einem fabrikneuen, kompletten Dreiachsfahrgestell (Los 1) und der Lieferung/Montage von einem fabrikneuen, kompletten Pressaufbau (21 bis 24 m³ Volumen, Los 2). Die vorgenannten Fahrzeugkomponenten werden durch den Auftragnehmer des Loses 2 zu einem kompletten Sperrgutpressfahrzeug zusammengebaut. Die Kompatibilität von Dreiachsfahrgestell und Pressaufbau ist durch eine DIN-gerechte Bauweise zwingend unverzichtbare Montagevoraussetzung. Es handelt sich um ein Dreiachsfahrgestell mit einem zulässigen Gesamtgewicht von 26.000 kg automatisierten Schaltgetriebe. Das Fahrzeug soll mit einem Pressaufbau ausgerüstet sein. Das Fahrzeug muss den Vorschriften der StVZO, den Regelwerken der UVV und den einschlägigen DIN-/EN- Normen sowie den EG- Richtlinien und den allgemein anerkannten, gültigen, sicherheitstechnischen und arbeitsmedizinischen Regeln entsprechen. Die Leistung ist wie folgt zu erbringen: • Zulieferung von einem Dreiachsfahrgestell durch den Auftragnehmer aus Los 1 an den Standort des Auftragnehmers aus Los 2 • Abnahme (stellvertretend für den Auftraggeber) und Zwischenlagerung des zugelieferten Dreiachsfahrgestells (Los 2) • Lieferung/ Montage von des Pressaufbaus (Los 2) • Komplettmontage, Zulassung (StVZO und Fahrtenschreiber), Auslieferung/Übergabe/Abnahme des Komplettfahrzeuges bei den TBR (Los 2) • Lieferung/Montage OBU – Mautsystem (Los 1) • Bereitstellung der losspezifischen technischen Unterlagen (alle Lose) • Schulung des Werkstattpersonals und Einweisung des Bedienpersonals (alle Lose) • Sicherstellung der Ersatzteillieferungen der gängigsten Ersatzteile (alle Lose)

title: Varmekartlegging og sårbarhet for hetebølger i Trondheim
description: 1. Generelt om oppdragetTrondheim kommune, heretter kalt oppdragsgiver, innbyr til åpen anbudskonkurranse i forbindelse med inngåelse av avtale på “Varmekartlegging og sårbarhet for hetebølger i Trondheim”. Konkurransen kunngjøres i DOFFIN, se www.doffin.no, gjennom oppdragsgiverens konkurransegjennomføringsverktøy (KGV) Mercell.2. BakgrunnTemperaturen i Norge har økt og vil fortsette å øke som følge av klimaendringene. Som følge av den generelle temperaturøkningen vil vi oftere oppleve perioder med ekstrem varme, såkalte “hetebølger”. En “norsk hetebølge” er definert som fem eller flere sammenhengende dager der maksimumtemperaturen er 27 grader eller høyere.Globalt har antallet hetebølger for perioden 2013-2022 økt med 94% sammenlignet med perioden 1986-2005. Også i Norge er det observert en markant økning i antallet hetebølger, samt en geografisk spredning av fenomenet, hvor hetebølger nå oppstår i områder hvor det tidligere har vært uvanlig.Urbane strøk er særlig utsatt for ekstrem varme på grunn av at bygningsmasse og harde overflater, som asfalt, både lagrer og reflekterer varme i nærområdet, noe som bidrar til å forsterke oppvarmingen. Forbrenning og varmetap fra trafikk og industri bidrar også til å øke temperaturen. Dette kalles “varmeøy-effekten”.Trær og annen vegetasjon spiller en viktig rolle for å regulere temperaturen lokalt. Grønne tak kan gi opp til 25 grader lavere temperatur på taket sammenlignet med konvensjonell takpapp. Tilsvarende kan gaterom og parker med vegetasjon gi en lokal temperatursenkning på inntil 10 grader. Med økende varmeproblematikk i urbane miljøer, blir grønnstruktur et viktig verktøy i arealplanlegginga for å redusere de negative effektene. Ekstrem varme bidrar til økt dødelighet og flere negative helsekonsekvenser. I perioden 2000-2019 ble det registrert 20 000 ekstra dødsfall per år, som følge av ekstrem varme i Europa. Hetebølger sammenfaller ofte med økt luftforurensing, noe som øker dødeligheten som følge av kardiovaskulære og respiratoriske sykdommer. I tillegg kan varmen gi dehydrering, heteslag, hodepine, dårlig søvn og redusert allmennstilstand. I Norge ble det påvist økt dødelighet under hetebølgen i 2025 , mens både Sverige og Finland registrerte økt dødelighet i forbindelse med hetebølgen i 2018.Noen befolkningsgrupper er særlig sårbare for ekstrem varme, f.eks. eldre, små barn og personer med underliggende sykdommer. I tillegg har lavinntektsgrupper, minoriteter, og leietakere som bor i gamle bygg lavere tilpasningsevne ved en hetebølge.Mange land og lokale myndigheter i Europa har utarbeidet rutiner og tiltaksplaner for å redusere de negative effektene av hetebølger. Forskning på tidligere hetebølger tyder på at byer, som har innført tilpasningstiltak og handlingsplaner for ekstrem varme, reduserer sammenhengen mellom hetebølger og negative helseeffekter. Det kan derfor antas at tilpasningstiltak er en effektiv måte for å redusere de negative konsekvensene. I Danmark oppgir en tredjedel av alle kommunene at de jobber med tilpasning til hetebølger, og i Sverige har over 80% av kommunene utarbeidet beredskapsplaner for høye temperaturer for sårbare grupper. I Norge har konsekvenser av hetebølger i liten grad blitt inkludert og håndtert i planverk og handlingsplaner, verken på nasjonalt, regionalt eller kommunalt nivå.

Belgoprocess nv zal optreden als aankoopcentrale en zal SCK CEN en ESV EURIDICE als deelnemende entiteiten opnemen in de raamovereenkomst. De opdracht omvat meer specifiek : - het ophalen van selectief ingezamelde bedrijfsafvalstoffen op verschillende locaties; - het daartoe verhuren van inzamelrecipiënten en het ledigen en/of afvoeren ervan; - het zo milieuvriendelijk mogelijk (laten) verwerken van het afval, overeenkomstig de wettelijke verplichtingen. title: Denmark – Architectural and related services – Ny cykel- og gangbro ved Sønder Havn
description: Med lokalplan 1119 er der skabt grundlag for etablering af en supplerende bro, parallelt og nord for den eksisterende blå klapbro i Søndre Havn, der både muliggør en ombygning af den eksisterende bro og forbedrer trafiksikkerheden for cyklister og gående. På den baggrund inviterer Køge Kommune (Ordregiver) til projektkonkurrence om udarbejdelse af et konceptuelt stærkt og realiserbart idéoplæg for en ny gang- og cykelbro. Konkurrencen omfatter – udover indgivelse af ovennævnte idéoplæg - afgivelse af tilbud på de efterfølgende rådgivningsydelser, herunder projektering, udarbejdelse af udbudsprojekt samt byggeledelse og fagtilsyn i forbindelse med realiseringen af projektet. Udbuddet forventes gennemført i følgende faser. 1) Gennemførelse af prækvalifikation med udvælgelse af 3-5 deltagere 2) Fremsendte tilbudte idéforslag, som en del af tilbuddet, vurderes af en bedømmelseskomité på baggrund af bedømmelseskriterierne 3) Mulighed for indledning af forhandling med vinderen af projektkonkurrencen på baggrund af estimater, timepriser, CV’ere, udkast til tidsplan, mv. som udgør en del af tilbuddet.

title: Finland – Lighting equipment and electric lamps – Kansallismuseon näyttelykäyttöön tarkoitetut kohdevalaisimet sekä niihin liittyvät vaihdettavat optiikat
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Museoviraston / Kansallismuseon ("Hankintayksikkö") museon näyttelykäyttöön tarkoitetut kohdevalaisimet sekä niihin liittyvät vaihdettavat optiikat ja muut tarjouspyynnössä määritellyt lisävarusteet ("Tavara"). Hankittavien tuotteiden määrät ja tekniset vähimmäisvaatimukset on esitetty liitteenä olevassa valaisinluettelossa. Valaisimien tulee olla suoraan mekaanisesti ja sähköisesti yhteensopivia Kansallismuseon olemassa olevien ERCO 3-vaihevalokiskojen kanssa. Valaisimien runkomateriaalin tulee olla alumiinia. Valaisimiin tulee olla saatavana tarjouspyynnössä määritellyt vaihdettavat optiikat sekä värilämpötilaa lämpimämpään ja kylmempään suuntaan muuttavat suodattimet (Cold, Cold Plus, Warm ja Warm Plus tai vastaavat). Tavaralla tulee olla vähintään viiden (5) vuoden tuotetakuu. Takuu- ja huoltopalvelujen tulee olla saatavilla suomen kielellä. Tavara tulee toimittaa 29.1.2027 mennessä. Valituksi tulevan toimittajan tulee pyrkiä toimittamaan Tavara mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen tekemisen jälkeen ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan ennen määräaikaa. Tarkempi aikataulu sovitaan valitun toimittajan kanssa. Aikataulussa on huomioitava, että Tavaran toimitus tapahtuu museon avaamisprojektin aikana. Edellä mainitusta syystä Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden tarjouspyynnössä esitettyjen ajankohtien aikataulumuutoksiin. HUOM! 19.10.2026 Hankintayksikkö on korjannut korjausilmoituksella tarjouspyynnön liitettä. Hankintayksikkö on korjannut liiteessä "Kansallismuseo_näyttelyvalopaketti" solussa F10 olleen virheellisen lukuarvon. Uudessa liitteessä "Kansallismuseo_näyttelyvalopaketti korjaus" lukuarvo on korjattu. Lisäksi hankintayksikkö on korjauksesta johtuen pidentänyt kilpailutuksen määräaikaa sekä kysymysten jättämisen ja vastausten antamisen määräaikoja.

title: Tau radiotracers for Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging
description: SAM.gov SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Solicitation Number: 75N98027Q00029 Title: Tau radiotracers for Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging Classification Code: 6505 NAICS Code: 325414 Description: Biological Product (except Diagnostic) Manufacturing This is a Small Business Sources Sought Notice. This is NOT a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations. The purpose of this notice is to obtain information regarding: (1) the availability and capability of qualified small business sources; (2) whether they are small businesses; HUBZone small businesses; service-disabled, veteran-owned small businesses; 8(a) small businesses; veteran-owned small businesses; woman-owned small businesses; or small disadvantaged businesses; (3) their size classification relative to the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for the proposed acquisition. Your responses to the information requested will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method, including whether a set-aside is possible. An organization that is not considered a small business under the applicable NAICS code should not submit a response to this notice. This notice is issued to help determine the availability of qualified companies technically capable of meeting the Government requirement and to determine the method of acquisition. It is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or ultimately award a contract. Responses will not be considered as proposals or quotes. No award will be made as a result of this notice. The Government will NOT be responsible for any costs incurred by the respondents to this notice. This notice is strictly for research and information purposes only. Background: The BLSA was initiated in 1958 and is a multi-disciplinary study of physiologic and psychologic aspects of normal aging in community-dwelling men and women. Since 1994, we have been conducting a longitudinal brain imaging study of selected older adults in the BLSA to characterize individual differences in longitudinal brain changes, to investigate the extent to which these brain changes underlie individual differences in cognitive aging, to identify brain changes that may be predictors of cognitive decline and Alzheimer�s disease (AD), and to assess the impact of potential modulators of brain and cognitive aging. More recently, we have been collecting in vivo measures of brain amyloid and tau, the hallmark pathologies of AD, using PET scanning. The purpose of this acquisition is to acquire FDA- approved second generation tau PET imaging radioligand to perform in vivo Positron Emission Tomography (PET) scans to measure brain tau neuropathology in BLSA participants on a combined PET/computed tomography (CT) scanner. Purpose and Objectives: The purpose of this acquisition is to procure Tau radiotracers for the Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging. Project requirements: Independently, and not as an agent of the Government, the Contractor shall provide the following: 95 Tau radioligand doses for the base period. 95 Tau radioligand doses for option period 1. 95 Tau radioligand doses for option period 2. Anticipated period of performance: Base Year: November 18, 2026 � November 17, 2027 Option Year 1: November 18, 2027 � November 17, 2028 Option Year 2: November 18, 2028 � November 17, 2029 Requested Response: The intent of this sources sought notice is to define the procurement strategy (e.g. set-aside, sole source, unrestricted) for a solicitation that is intended to be posted soon. Interested contractors are requested to respond by (1) identifying how their proposed product meets or exceeds the project requirements listed above; and (2) providing product literature, white papers, or capability statements that demonstrate their bona fide ability to supply such an item within the time frame described above. In addition, please state your business size status and whether you are the manufacturer or authorized distributor of the item you propose. Please note that NIH is particularly interested in small business sources. If you are a small business, please state the type of small business (small business; HUBZone; service-disabled, veteran-owned; 8(a); veteran-owned; woman-owned; or small disadvantaged businesses) and your size classification relative to the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for the proposed acquisition. Your responses to the information requested will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method, including whether a set-aside is possible. The respondent must also provide their DUNS number, organization name, address, point of contact, and size and type of business (e.g., 8(a), HubZone, etc.), pursuant to the applicable NAICS code and any other information that may be helpful in developing or finalizing the acquisition requirements. The information submitted must be must be in an outline format that addresses each of the elements of the project requirements and in the capability statement /information sought paragraphs stated herein. A cover page and an executive summary may be included but is not required. The response must include the respondents� technical and administrative points of contact, including names, titles, addresses, telephone and fax numbers, and e-mail addresses. All responses to this notice must be submitted electronically to the Contracting Officer. Facsimile responses are NOT accepted. The response must be submitted to Kevin Alvarez, Contracting Officer, at e-mail address kevin.alvarez@nih.gov. The response must be received on or before October 27, 2026, 9:00am, Eastern Time. Disclaimer and Important Notes: This notice does not obligate the Government to award a contract or otherwise pay for the information provided in response. The Government reserves the right to use information provided by respondents for any purpose deemed necessary and legally appropriate. Any organization responding to this notice should ensure that its response is complete and sufficiently detailed to allow the Government to determine the organization�s qualifications to perform the work. Respondents are advised that the Government is under no obligation to acknowledge receipt of the information received or provide feedback to respondents with respect to any information submitted. After a review of the responses received, a presolicitation synopsis and solicitation may be published at SAM.gov. However, responses to this notice will not be considered adequate responses to a solicitation. Confidentiality: No proprietary, classified, confidential, or sensitive information should be included in your response. The Government reserves the right to use any non-proprietary technical information in any resultant solicitation(s).

title: Felles EPJ for den offentlige tannhelsetjenesten
description: Konkurransen gjelder levering av en felles elektronisk pasientjournal (EPJ) for den offentlige tannhelsetjenesten, med integrasjon mot felles lagringsløsning. Løsningen leveres som en løpende tjeneste som inkluderer drift, utvikling og forvaltning. Anskaffelsens verdi anslås til over EØS terskelverdi. Volumet er et estimat og er ikke bindende for oppdragsgiver. For nærmere informasjon viser vi til anskaffelsesdokumentene. Et utkast til selve konkurransegrunnlaget er lagt ved dette kvalifiseringsgrunnlaget. Oppdragsgiver forbeholder seg retten til å foreta mindre, ikke vesentlige endringer i dette grunnlaget før leverandører inviteres til å gi tilbud. Oppdragsgiver tar forbehold om avlysning av konkurransen, blant annet i forbindelse med budsjettmessig dekning. Denne anskaffelsen er etter sin art vurdert til å ha en uvesentlig innvirkning på klima og miljø, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5b tredje ledd. Begrunnelsen for dette er at anskaffelsen gjelder kjøp av en digital løsning for den offentlige tannhelsetjenesten der anskaffelsens art medfører at oppdragsgiver er avskåret fra å påvirke klima og miljøpåvirkningen, siden krav og kriterier som retter seg mot disse elementene ikke vil ha tilstrekkelig tilknytning til leveransen, jf. DFØs miljøveileder. Plikten til å stille krav om lærling er vurdert til å gjelde for denne anskaffelsen, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5h. Se kontrakten for mer informasjon.

Requirement Details Tendering Procedure: Selective Tendering This requirement is open only to those TBIPS Supply Arrangement Holders who qualified under Tier 1 for services in the National Capital Region for the following categories: • Category A.1. Application/Software Architect Level 3 • Category I.2. Database Administrator Level 3 • Category I.6. Network Analyst Level 3 • Category I.11. Technology Architect Level 3 The following SA Holders have been invited to submit a proposal: • Accenture Inc. • ADRM Technology Consulting Group Corp. • BoonBridge Corporation • CDW Canada Corp. • CGI Information Systems and Management Consultants Inc. • Cofomo Inc. • Deloitte Inc. • Donna Cona Inc., IBM Canada Limited Joint Venture • Flex Tech Services Inc • Primex Project Management Limited • Prologic Systems Ltd., and Maplesoft Consulting Inc. in JV • Skyfly Solutions Inc., iFathom Corp., EPI-Use Now Inc. in Joint Venture • Spaghetti Logic Inc. • TRM Technologies Inc. • Xelerance Corporation Description of Work: The objective of this requirement is to augment knowledge within the Department of Justice Canada’s (JUS) Cloud team to gather expertise and meet project requirements and specific AI initiatives. The required professional services will support the delivery of key infrastructure components, networking fixes and improvements as well as high visibility projects such as Otto , Artificial Intelligence and the Lakehouse. The Cloud Engineer will implement, configure, automate, and support cloud infrastructure, platform services, and cloud-native solutions in accordance with Government of Canada Cloud Guardrails, departmental standards, enterprise architecture principles, and security controls. The Cloud Engineer will support the deployment, integration, modernization, and operational management of Microsoft Azure services, enterprise applications, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid cloud environments. The Cloud Engineer will collaborate with the Cloud Centre of Expertise (CCoE), Shared Services Canada (SSC), Security Operations, infrastructure teams, application teams, and project stakeholders to deploy, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, automate, and document cloud services, platform components, application hosting environments, identity services, storage, networking, and operational processes while supporting continuous improvement, operational excellence, and knowledge transfer. The Cloud Architect will design, document, and provide technical leadership for the Department's cloud architecture, ensuring compliance with Government of Canada Cloud Guardrails, departmental standards, security controls, and enterprise architecture principles. The Cloud Architect will support cloud infrastructure, cloud-native applications, application modernization initiatives, Azure platform services, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid architectures. Responsibilities include the design of governance models, subscription hierarchies, landing zones, security architecture, integration patterns, DevSecOps practices, application hosting models, and reference architectures to support enterprise cloud adoption and integration with on-premises and cloud-based services. The Network Specialist will design, implement, document, and support cloud and hybrid networking solutions that provide secure, resilient, and high-performing connectivity between cloud, on-premises, partner, and externally hosted environments. The specialist will support enterprise cloud platforms, cloud-native applications, application modernization initiatives, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid architectures by designing and implementing networking services, secure integration patterns, and connectivity solutions. The Network Specialist will collaborate with Shared Services Canada (SSC), internal Security Operations, infrastructure teams, application teams, and project stakeholders to design, implement, validate, and document network connectivity, firewall configurations, DNS services, certificate management, identity integration, private connectivity, and network security controls in accordance with Government of Canada standards and departmental policies. The Database Administrator will design, implement, maintain, and optimize database platforms across on-premises and Azure environments, ensuring the availability, performance, security, and recoverability of business-critical systems. The Database Administrator will implement and support backup, restore, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and security controls, while providing technical advice and documentation related to database migrations, cloud integration, and operational best practices in coordination with application teams, Shared Services Canada (SSC), and internal security stakeholders. Bidders must submit a bid for all resource categories. Security Requirement: All Contractor personnel must hold at a minimum, a Personnel security screening level of Reliability. Privileged users require a Personnel Security screening level of Secret. Unscreened personnel are prohibited from performing services under the Contract. title: A.1. Application/Software Architect – Level 3
description: ISED is currently modernizing and maturing its end-to-end systems development lifecycle and project management lifecycle processes. The Application Software Architect – Level 3 will support the modernization, configuration, enhancement and ongoing evolution of the Clarity PPM platform throughout the two-year contract period. The resource will provide architecture, technical design, configuration, integration, analysis, documentation and technical advisory services in support of ISED's Clarity PPM environment. The resource will work under the direction of the Project Authority, who will establish priorities and assign work based on departmental requirements, the Clarity PPM roadmap and emerging business and technical needs. The resource will perform tasks including, but not limited to, the following: A. Architecture and Technical Design - Develop technical architectures, frameworks and strategies, either for an organization or for a major application area, to meet the business and application requirements. - Analyze functional requirements to identify information, procedures and decision flows. - Define input/output sources, including detailed plan for technical design phase, and obtain approval of the system proposal. - Advise on implementation paths, integration, interoperability and risk mitigation strategies relating to the implementation of Clarity PPM specific to the ISED Test and Production environments. B. Business Requirements Analysis - Elicit and analyze business requirements and related processes while adhering to relevant government policies and directives. C. Documentation and Standards - Evaluate existing procedures and methods, identify and document database content, structure, and application sub-systems, and develop data dictionary. - Define and document interfaces of manual to automated operations within application sub-systems, to external systems and between new and existing systems. - Identify and document system specific standards relating to programming, documentation and testing such as program libraries, data dictionaries, naming conventions. D. Clarity PPM Configuration and Advisory Services - Provide advice and hands-on services to architect and configure Clarity PPM in version 16.3x or more recent version. - Provide advice and hands-on expertise related to reporting requirements, including reporting to Treasury Board. - Provide advice and expertise on Government of Canada direction in Clarity PPM implementations. - Provide advice and expertise on private sector direction in Clarity PPM implementations.

title: Advance Procurement Notice - Independent Certifier for Alexandra Bridge Replacement Project
description: His Majesty the King in right of Canada, as represented by the Minister of Public Works and Government Services Canada and operating as Public Service Procurement Canada (“PSPC” or “Canada”), is contemplating a procurement process for the provision of Independent Certifier ("IC") services for the Alexandra Bridge Replacement Project (the “Project”). The purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice ("APN") is to provide interested parties with preliminary information regarding the requirement and the anticipated procurement process for the provision of IC services for the Project (the "Procurement Process"). This APN is also intended to promote early market awareness and engagement with organizations that possess the qualifications and experience required to deliver IC services for the Project. title: RFP – Pilot Scale Multi-Mode Arc Furnace
description: Please note that late submissions will not be considered or accepted. Description of Requirement: Natural Resources Canada requires a detailed engineering design and timeline for a pilot scale multi-mode arc furnace together with power supply and control systems, a continuous feeding system, a primary off-gas treatment system and ancillary equipment. The requirement includes the option for the Contractor to fabricate the furnace and deliver it to CanmetMATERIALS' Hamilton laboratory, with additional options for the purchase of spare parts and additional technical support. The delivery and completion of the detailed engineering design must be completed by March 1 2027, the period of the contract is from contract award to March 31 2028. If the option to produce the furnace is exercised, the furnace must be delivered, commissioned, and installed by March 1 2029, and the term of the contract will be extended to March 31 2031. Canada will hold an Offeror’s conference virtually on September 23 2026, beginning at 1:00 PM EDT. Participation in this conference is optional.

title: EB144-270878 - ITT - AHU Replacement at BIO
description: Public Services and Procurement Canada, on behalf of Fisheries and Oceans Canada, is seeking offers from qualified contractors for the replacement of the existing air handling unit and associated mechanical and electrical systems serving the Core Storage Facility at the Bedford Institute of Oceanography in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia. This Invitation to Tender represents the second phase of a two-phase procurement process and is open only to contractors that successfully qualified through the Invitation to Qualify stage. The work generally includes the removal and replacement of the existing air handling unit, heating pumps, heat exchanger, associated piping systems, air distribution components, controls, and related electrical infrastructure. The project also includes all required testing, balancing, commissioning, and associated construction services necessary to place the new systems into operation.

description: Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) has a requirement for a Regional Individual Standing Offer (RISO) for the services of a diving firm to perform diving inspections and minor repairs on marine structures and facilities at various locations in Newfoundland and Labrador.
